title: Quick Facts within 5

blocks.html: You can solve story problems and break numbers apart. Now let’s get quick with small facts.

blocks.name: tenframe
blocks.cap: $2 + 3 = 5$. One full row of a ten frame is 5.

blocks.html: Facts within 5 can become quick to know, like your own name. One hand is 5 fingers, so your hand can help.
When small facts are quick, your mind is free for bigger problems. And every fact within 5 fits on one hand.
For grown-ups: Play quick, short games in the car or at the table: “What is 2 and 2? What is 5 take away 1?” Stop while it is still fun.
